svg.text: Stage31 candidate A: Headers kept; two shallow notches in the middle carrier left rail
Design study only: modelled envelopes are not physical clearance. Blue J-SIG, red J-PWR; the wide stroke is the modelled bundle diameter. Dashed boxes are release sweeps.
Steel = carrier rails/crossmembers/tabs; orange = rail left under a proposed notch, dashed orange = material removed; green outline = A01 boards; tan = A01 parts (3 mm assumed);
light grey = foreign part XY (plan) or the foreign PCB rear (side/section); the depth behind it is unknown and is reported as a bound.

Side (XZ, y 140–192 projected): release and core service
